title: Community detection with the Bethe-Hessian
abstract: arXiv:2411.02835v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Bethe-Hessian matrix, introduced by Saade, Krzakala, and Zdeborov\'a (2014), is a Hermitian matrix designed for applying spectral clustering algorithms to sparse networks. Rather than employing a non-symmetric and high-dimensional non-backtracking operator, a spectral method based on the Bethe-Hessian matrix is conjectured to also reach the Kesten-Stigum detection threshold in the sparse stochastic block model (SBM). We provide the first rigorous analysis of the Bethe-Hessian spectral method in the SBM under both the bounded expected degree and the growing degree regimes. translated_abstract: Bethe-Hessian矩阵由Saade、Krzakala和Zdeborová（2014）提出，是一种用于将谱聚类算法应用于稀疏网络的厄米特矩阵。与采用非对称且高维的非回溯算子不同，基于Bethe-Hessian矩阵的谱方法被推测同样能够在稀疏随机块模型（SBM）中达到Kesten-Stigum检测阈值。本文首次在有界期望度和期望度增长两种情形下，对SBM中的Bethe-Hessian谱方法进行了严格分析。具体而言，我们证明了：(i) 当期望度 d≥2 时，Bethe-Hessian矩阵的负离群特征值个数能够一致地估计高于Kesten-Stigum阈值时的区块数量，从而证实了Saade、Krzakala和Zdeborová（2014）在 d≥2 情形下提出的猜想；(ii) 对于足够大的 d，其特征向量可以一致地恢复（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文首次对稀疏随机块模型中的Bethe-Hessian谱方法进行了严格分析，证明其可达到Kesten-Stigum检测阈值，并证实了矩阵负离群特征值个数能一致估计区块数量的猜想。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first rigorous analysis of the Bethe-Hessian spectral method in sparse stochastic block models, proving it achieves the Kesten-Stigum detection threshold and confirming that the number of negative outliers of the matrix consistently estimates the number of blocks.
